A '''space station''' contained a shopping area and a [[Broom's laboratory|secret laboratory]] in which [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Cantebarius H. Broom]] experimented on [[Droid/Legends|droids]]<ref name="TO">{{StoryCite|story=Troublesome Outing|book=MyComyc|bformatted=''MyComyc'' 5}}</ref> due to paranoia relating to droids being after him upon his discovery of there being eighteen [[Abominor]]s in the galaxy, including the [[Great Heep]].<ref name="tdr-a">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> Around [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Polyhedron">In "[[Troublesome Outing]]", [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] belong to [[Jann Tosh]], whose ownership of them occurs around [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] according to {{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}.</ref> the [[Mining/Legends|miner]] [[Jann Tosh]] traveled to the station with his droids, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol unit]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. While Tosh had gone shopping, C-3PO fell through a trapdoor leading to Broom's lair, but he was saved from the professor's clutches in extremis.<ref name="TO" />
